narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three hundred thirty four makes whole packs, because it ends in four.
<bookmark mark='left'/>Pack them in fours, and eighty three packs are filled with two stickers left over.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The last digit alone cannot tell us whether the packs come out whole.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>To test a big number for four, look only at the number made by its last two digits.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Which numbers between five thousand seven hundred ten and five thousand seven hundred twenty are multiples of four?
